english.meaning: all at once; paying everything in one lump sum

exampleSentences.english: I think if I’m sure I won’t buy a new car, I’ll pay it all upfront, then just pay for parking and gas each month.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我諗如果我肯定唔會買新車，噉即係一筆過俾晒，跟住每個月就係俾停車場同埋油囖。
